data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, St. Giuliana is celebrated as a martyr who lived during the 3rd century in Salerno, Italy. She is the patron saint of housewives, young women, engaged couples, and childless women. Her life story is one of faith, perseverance, and devotion, inspiring countless numbers of Christians to remain steadfast in their faith and to trust in God's plan for their lives. Her feast day is celebrated on May 4th, and she is venerated as an example of purity, patience, and love.
